text: The governing reliability statistic for the frozen V3 annotation gate is tracklet-level Cohen's kappa INCLUDING UNLABELABLE as a category. UNLABELABLE is a prespecified substantive annotation category and is not removed from the primary reliability assessment. Kappa excluding items where either annotator selected UNLABELABLE remains a required secondary diagnostic. Raw agreement, both kappa values, unit-level reserve agreement and every disagreement remain mandatory reporting. If kappa including UNLABELABLE < 0.60 the result is PROVISIONAL and the primary outcome cannot exceed MODIFY. Kappa >= 0.60 only passes the reliability gate and is not validation.
tool_change: only the reporting of the governing gate (kappa including UNLABELABLE) and relabelling of the secondary diagnostic; no change to computation
